# Mohammad Aghaie

> Mohammad Aghaie is a theoretical physicist and postdoctoral researcher in the particle physics theory group at the University of Osaka (Japan), working with Ryosuke Sato. His research covers dark matter, axions and axion-like particles (ALPs), ultralight dark matter, the strong CP problem and physics beyond the Standard Model. He received his PhD from the University of Pisa (Italy) with Paolo Panci.

This is his personal academic website. Official profiles: [INSPIRE-HEP](https://inspirehep.net/authors/2688235), [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0002-6945-2622), [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=tKmk0DkAAAAJ), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammad-aghaie-070427233/).

- [Talks](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/talks/): seminars and conference talks, with abstracts and event links
- [News](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/news/): papers, talks and other updates
- [Blog](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/blog/): notes on dark matter, axions and physics beyond the Standard Model, and an essay on AI and science
- [CV](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/cv/): education, positions, awards and service
- [Contact](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/contact/)

## Papers

- [Neutron disappearance and the LZ nuclear recoil event](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/publications/neutron-disappearance-lz/) (with A. Strumia, 2026)
- [Anomaly-free axion-like particle in Nelson–Barr models](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/publications/nelson-barr-alp/) (with R. Masuda and R. Sato, 2026)
- [Self-interaction bounds on ultralight dark matter couplings to matter](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/publications/uldm-self-interactions/) (with S. Li, 2026)
- [A particle on a ring, or: how I learned to stop worrying and love θ-vacua](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/publications/theta-vacua/) (with R. Sato, JHEP 2026)
- [Minimal Dark Matter in the sky: updated indirect detection probes](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/publications/minimal-dark-matter/) (JCAP 2026)
- [(H)ALPing the 511 keV line](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/publications/halping-511-kev/) (Phys. Lett. B 2026)
- [Axion dark matter from heavy quarks](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/publications/axion-dark-matter-heavy-quarks/) (Phys. Lett. B 2024)
- [Bounds on ultralight dark matter from NANOGrav](https://mohammadaghaie.github.io/publications/ultralight-dark-matter-nanograv/) (Phys. Rev. D 2024)
